title: Microphone icon inappropriately appears when an application (like PulseEffects) is using a recording PulseAudio sink monitor
line: When an app only records what the speakers play, the tray now shows a record icon saying it is recording the audio output, not that it uses the microphone.
explanation: The microphone indicator lists every non-virtual recording stream and calls it microphone use, without checking what the stream records. PulseAudioQt drops sink monitors from SourceModel, so a stream recording the speaker output (PulseEffects, visualizers, screen recorders) was announced as "<app> is using the microphone" whenever any microphone exists, which on laptops is always. Open MR plasma-pa!423 (Kacper Paczos) looks up each stream's device among the sinks' monitor indices: when only monitors are recorded the item shows media-record-symbolic and "<app> is recording the audio output (<device>)"; streams on real capture devices keep the microphone wording.

commits.message:
[Microphone Indicator] Tell recording the audio output apart from using the microphone

A recording stream attached to the monitor of a sink captures what the
speakers play, not what a microphone hears. Both cases produced the same
label so far: "<app> is using the microphone", next to a microphone icon,
even when no capture device was touched at all.

PulseAudioQt drops monitor sources from SourceModel (source_cb() in
context.cpp returns early for them), so a stream recording a monitor never
matches an entry there. Sinks do know their monitor's index, so the two
cases can be told apart by looking at SinkModel.

When nothing records an actual capture device, the item now shows
media-record-symbolic and says "<app> is recording the audio output
(<device>)". Streams on real capture devices are untouched. The item still
appears in both cases, so nothing that used to be signalled stops being
signalled - only the wording and the icon change for the monitor case.

BUG: 498362
CCBUG: 410637

media.caption: Master: parecord records only the speaker output, yet the tray says it is using the microphone
With the MR: record icon, "Audio Output Recorded", "parecord is recording the audio output (Dummy Output)"
With the MR, a second parecord on the stand-in microphone: back to the microphone icon and wording

review.text: This is Kacper's MR plasma-pa!423 applied unchanged. It tells monitor-source recording apart by matching the stream's device against the sinks' monitorIndex (needed because PulseAudioQt drops monitors from SourceModel) and only changes the icon and wording, which respects Kai's objection to hiding the item. Real microphone streams are untouched, as the second after-shot shows. The remaining wart is that the Mute action still mutes the microphone in the monitor-only case; it is worth raising on the MR, but it doesn't block the MR. Keeping CCBUG 410637 is correct since the item is still shown.
